words.display: /* 1行コメント */ SELECT /* ブロックコメント */ 1;
words.input: /* 1行コメント */ SELECT /* ブロックコメント */ 1;

words.display: SELECT * FROM users WHERE active AND (age >= 20 OR age IS NULL);
words.input: SELECT * FROM users WHERE active AND (age >= 20 OR age IS NULL);
words.annotation: AND / OR / NOT：条件を組み合わせる（混在時は括弧で意図を明示）

words.display: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC;
words.input: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC;
words.annotation: ORDER BY：並べ替え（指定しない取得順は保証されない）

words.display: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id > 100 ORDER BY id LIMIT 20;
words.input: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id > 100 ORDER BY id LIMIT 20;
words.annotation: キ―セットページング：前回の続きから取得（前回の最終id等を使用）

words.display: SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY department_id;
words.input: SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY department_id;
words.annotation: GROUP BY：グループ単位に集計

words.display: SELECT STRING_AGG(name, ', ' ORDER BY id) FROM users;
words.input: SELECT STRING_AGG(name, ', ' ORDER BY id) FROM users;
words.annotation: STRING_AGG：文字列を連結（順番が必要なら集計内でORDER BY）

words.input: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM orders);
words.annotation: スカラーサブクエリ：単一値を式に使う（複数行を返すとエラー）

words.display: SELECT id FROM users WHERE active UNION ALL SELECT id FROM users WHERE NOT active;
words.input: SELECT id FROM users WHERE active UNION ALL SELECT id FROM users WHERE NOT active;
words.annotation: UNION / UNION ALL：結果を連結（UNIONは重複排除、UNION ALLは保持）

words.display: INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ('Pomo') RETURNING id, name;
words.input: INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ('Pomo') RETURNING id, name;
words.annotation: RETURNING：変更した行を返す（UPDATE・DELETEでも使用可能）

words.display: UPDATE users SET age = age + 1 WHERE id = 1 RETURNING id, age;
words.input: UPDATE users SET age = age + 1 WHERE id = 1 RETURNING id, age;
words.annotation: UPDATE / SET / WHERE：行を更新（WHEREなしは全行更新）

words.display: DELETE FROM orders o USING users u WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND NOT u.active;
words.input: DELETE FROM orders o USING users u WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND NOT u.active;
words.annotation: DELETE ... USING：結合条件で削除

words.input: CREATE TABLE counters (id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY);
words.annotation: IDENTITY：自動採番列（値の連続性・欠番なしを保証しない）

words.display: ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT users_name_unique UNIQUE (name);
words.input: ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT users_name_unique UNIQUE (name);
words.annotation: UNIQUE：一意制約（既存の重複があると失敗。通常NULL同士は同値としない）

words.display: ALTER TABLE orders ADD CONSTRAINT orders_amount_positive CHECK (amount >= 0);
words.input: ALTER TABLE orders ADD CONSTRAINT orders_amount_positive CHECK (amount >= 0);
words.annotation: CHECK：行の条件制約（条件がNULLの場合も通る。必要ならNOT NULLも併用）

words.display: ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN age TYPE bigint USING age::bigint;
words.input: ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN age TYPE bigint USING age::bigint;
words.annotation: ALTER COLUMN TYPE：列型を変更（ロック・書き換えの負荷が発生する場合がある）

words.display: ALTER TABLE users RENAME COLUMN nickname TO display_name;
words.input: ALTER TABLE users RENAME COLUMN nickname TO display_name;
words.annotation: RENAME COLUMN / TO：列名・表名を変更（この例はnickname列がある場合）

words.display: CREATE TABLE user_snapshot AS SELECT id, name FROM users;
words.input: CREATE TABLE user_snapshot AS SELECT id, name FROM users;
words.annotation: CREATE TABLE AS：検索結果で表を作る（元表の制約・インデックス等は通常引き継がない）
date / timestamp：日付・タイムゾーンなし日時（timestamp単独はwithout time zone）

words.display: SELECT name, CASE WHEN age >= 20 THEN '成人' ELSE 'その他' END FROM users;
words.input: SELECT name, CASE WHEN age >= 20 THEN '成人' ELSE 'その他' END FROM users;
words.annotation: CASE WHEN：条件に応じた値

words.display: SELECT name || 'さん', CONCAT(name, 'さん') FROM users;
words.input: SELECT name || 'さん', CONCAT(name, 'さん') FROM users;
words.annotation: || / CONCAT：文字列連結（||はNULLがあると通常NULL。CONCATはNULL引数を無視）

words.display: SELECT LOWER(name), UPPER(name), TRIM(name) FROM users;
words.input: SELECT LOWER(name), UPPER(name), TRIM(name) FROM users;
words.annotation: LOWER / UPPER / TRIM：文字列加工

words.display: SELECT LENGTH(name), SUBSTRING(name FROM 1 FOR 2) FROM users;
words.input: SELECT LENGTH(name), SUBSTRING(name FROM 1 FOR 2) FROM users;
words.annotation: LENGTH / SUBSTRING：長さ・部分文字列（LENGTH(text)は文字数）

words.display: SELECT profile->'address', profile->>'name' FROM users;
words.input: SELECT profile->'address', profile->>'name' FROM users;
words.annotation: -> / ->>：JSON要素の取得（->はJSON、->>はtext）

words.display: SELECT * FROM users WHERE profile @ > '{"premium":true}'::jsonb;
words.input: SELECT * FROM users WHERE profile @> '{"premium":true}'::jsonb;
words.annotation: @>：JSONB包含

words.display: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'name', name) FROM users;
words.input: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'name', name) FROM users;
words.annotation: jsonb_build_object：JSONBオブジェクトを構築

words.display: SELECT * FROM users WHERE tags && ARRAY['go', 'sql'];
words.input: SELECT * FROM users WHERE tags && ARRAY['go', 'sql'];
words.annotation: &&：配列の重なり

words.display: CREATE INDEX users_created_at_idx ON users(created_at);
words.input: CREATE INDEX users_created_at_idx ON users(created_at);
words.annotation: CREATE INDEX：検索用インデックス（読み取りが速くなる場合があるが更新・容量コストが増える）

words.display: CREATE INDEX orders_user_created_idx ON orders(user_id, created_at DESC);
words.input: CREATE INDEX orders_user_created_idx ON orders(user_id, created_at DESC);
words.annotation: 複合インデックス：複数列のインデックス（列順・条件・並べ替えに合わせて設計）

words.display: CREATE INDEX users_active_idx ON users(id) WHERE active;
words.input: CREATE INDEX users_active_idx ON users(id) WHERE active;
words.annotation: 部分インデックス：条件に合う行だけを索引化（クエリ条件と述語の関係が重要）

words.display: CREATE INDEX users_lower_email_idx ON users(LOWER(email));
words.input: CREATE INDEX users_lower_email_idx ON users(LOWER(email));
words.annotation: 式インデックス：式の結果を索引化

words.display: CREATE INDEX users_profile_gin_idx ON users USING GIN(profile);
words.input: CREATE INDEX users_profile_gin_idx ON users USING GIN(profile);
words.annotation: USING GIN：JSONB等向けGIN索引（演算子・演算子クラスにより対応が異なる）

words.display: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY users_age_idx ON users(age);
words.input: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY users_age_idx ON users(age);
words.annotation: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY：書き込みを止めにくい索引作成（トランザクションブロック内不可。失敗時に無効索引が残り得る）

words.display: CREATE VIEW active_users AS SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE active;
words.input: CREATE VIEW active_users AS SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE active;
words.annotation: CREATE VIEW：クエリをビューとして保存（通常は結果を保存しない）

words.input: BEGIN; UPDATE users SET active = false WHERE id = 1; COMMIT;
words.annotation: BEGIN / COMMIT：処理をまとめて確定（実行すると変更が確定）

words.input: BEGIN; UPDATE users SET active = false WHERE id = 1; ROLLBACK;
words.annotation: ROLLBACK：変更を取り消す（シーケンスの採番等は巻き戻らない）

words.input: BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE; SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 1; COMMIT;
words.annotation: ISOLATION LEVEL：分離レベルを指定（直列化失敗時はトランザクション全体の再試行が必要）

words.input: BEGIN; SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE; COMMIT;
words.annotation: FOR UPDATE：取得行を更新用にロック（ロックは通常トランザクション終了まで）

words.display: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 1;
words.input: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 1;
words.annotation: EXPLAIN ANALYZE：実行して実測計画を表示（対象SQLを実際に実行。UPDATE・DELETE等にも副作用がある）
